params.body:
## What
On the vehicle detail page (wide screens) the right-hand action column (price, buy over, offer, order, test drive) sometimes could not be scrolled to its last button: the column reached its own scroll end while the page stayed put, and "Bestelbon zonder schade" / "Aanvraag testrit" hung under the bottom edge.

## Why
The column is `position: sticky; top: 92px` with `max-height: calc(100vh - 108px)`. That height is right once the column is stuck, but it only sticks after the page has scrolled ~80px; before that its bottom sits 63px below the viewport. `overscroll-behavior: contain` on the column then blocked the wheel from handing over to the page when the column hit its end. Reproduced at 1440x800 and 1440x900 (last button cut off by 38px); "sometimes" was simply whether the user had first scrolled the page with the pointer over the photos.

## Fix
- `resources/css/refresh.css`: drop `overscroll-behavior: contain` on `.ui-buy-sidebar`; the max-height and sticky offset stay as they were. Phones were already non-sticky (the `lg:` classes only).
- `tests/Feature/BuyboxSidebarScrollTest.php`: guards that the column scrolls inside itself, that the sticky offset (92) and the max-height (108) still belong together, that no overscroll containment comes back, and that it is sticky on `lg` only.
- Rule R S5-3.14 in `docs/bedrijfsregels/15-s5-kopen-bij-een-collega.md`; finding `2026-09-15-koopkolom-laatste-knop-onbereikbaar.md` (opgelost).

## Verified
Playwright, wheel with the pointer over the column until nothing moves any more (main column padded to the height of a real photo gallery):
- before, 1440x800: column at its end, page at 0, last button bottom 838 > 800 (cut off 38px); 1440x900: same, 938 > 900.
- after, 1440x800: page scrolls on, column sticks at 92, last button bottom 656 (visible); 1440x900: 756 (visible).
- 390: unchanged, the column flows under the photos.
params.title: The detail page's action column scrolls to its last button
